markdown:
A few notes from my first year running a stall at the Saturday market. Customers remember the person, not the product, so talk to everyone. Price in round numbers; nobody wants to make change for $7.25. And bring a second cash box, because the first one will run out of ones by ten.

Happy to answer questions if you're thinking about starting.

labels.notes: Clean neutral advice post; sentence-initial "And" is deliberate.
